g.text: v1.1. answer() is a wrapper over answerFile().
The human rule applies only where the clinic file
had no answer, or gave only the phone or languages
line to a message that asks for a person and names
neither a number nor a language.
[the clinic file answers it ("What is the phone number to call back?")]
[no answer in the file (or only the phone or languages line) and the message asks for a person]
[Patient leaves a name and phone (the existing call-back form, J3)]
[Staff look for it with the v1.1 ticket tools]
the ids, statuses and replies of 1.0.0.0 are unchanged; the staff reply path is J4
